walkthroughs.body_html:
Some resources are finite — they'll run out.

Crude oil, natural gas, coal and metal ores are all finite.

Renewable resources are replaced as fast as we use them — like wind, wood and fresh water in rainy regions.

Chemistry helps by making products from sustainable sources and by recycling.

An LCA totals the environmental cost of a product from cradle to grave.

The four stages are:

1. Getting raw materials. 2. Manufacturing. 3. Using the product. 4. Disposal.

Each stage uses energy, water and produces waste. LCAs help us compare products fairly — for example, paper vs plastic bags.

Potable water is safe to drink — but it still contains dissolved salts, so it's not pure.

In the UK we get potable water by:

1. Choosing a fresh water source (lake, river, reservoir). 2. Filtering to remove solids. 3. Sterilising to kill microbes.

Sterilisation can use chlorine, UV light or ozone.

options: Crude oil
Natural gas
Wind
Iron ore

mcqs.q: Which stage is NOT part of a life cycle assessment?
options: Extracting raw materials
Manufacturing
The colour of the product
Disposal at end of life

mcqs.q: What does a curly arrow in an organic mechanism represent?
options: The movement of a pair of electrons from where they are to where they end up.
A curly arrow shows the direction in which heat is flowing in the reaction.
All endothermic reactions are spontaneous at room temperature.
A curly arrow shows the movement of an atom from one position to another.

mcqs.q: If a complex ion has a coordination number of 4, what shape does it have?
options: A curly arrow shows the direction in which heat is flowing in the reaction.
A coordination number of 4 always means tetrahedral, because that gives the maximum bond-angle separation.
It can be either tetrahedral OR square planar — the shape depends on the metal and ligands (e.g. [Pt(NH3)4]2+ is square planar; [CuCl4]2- is tetrahedral).
A coordination number of 4 always means square planar because complexes prefer to be flat.

mcqs.q: Why can an endothermic reaction still be spontaneous?
options: If the entropy increase (TΔS) is large enough to outweigh the positive ΔH, ΔG can still be negative.
A curly arrow shows the direction in which heat is flowing in the reaction.
All endothermic reactions are spontaneous at room temperature.
Endothermic reactions are never spontaneous because they require energy input.
